canonical.title: Day-trips within 30 km of Schloss Schauenstein

parent.title: A weekend in Fürstenau, anchored on Schauenstein

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Schloss Schauenstein
siblings.summary: After a 3-star tasting menu you don't want to drive. Four options in Fürstenau actually walk home — two on the Caminada estate, two third-party inns.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Schloss Schauenstein
siblings.summary: Nine characterful hotels, from in-castle suites to 1722 pass-village inns, all reachable by taxi from Fürstenau before or after dinner at Caminada's Schloss Schauenstein.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Schloss Schauenstein
siblings.summary: Nothing inside a strict 30 km radius rises to conference scale — Chur runs a small AI/SME meetup circuit; for a real conference pair Schauenstein with the Davos Tech Summit, 1–4 Jul 2026.
